player_intent: The browser game is one-click 32-player WebRTC tournament play plus a real global leaderboard; 2v2 exists only inside the tournament's eight concurrent arenas.
acceptance_rule: The restricted browser launcher shows JOIN 32-PLAYER TOURNAMENT, GLOBAL LEADERBOARD, and settings. It shows no private host, room code, manual address, or server-browser action. The signaling service automatically creates and fills tournament rooms up to 32 peers, peer 1 remains the authoritative match owner, the existing tournament runtime forms 16 duos across eight isolated 2v2 arenas, and the leaderboard reads a bounded anonymous-safe RPC without fabricated rows or user ids.

nodes.role: Requests automatic WebRTC tournament matchmaking and enters the canonical multiplayer scene.
Opens and refreshes real tournament standings from the bounded public leaderboard contract.
Owns the connected lobby, 16 duos, eight arena assignments, bracket advancement, rounds, and authoritative combat decisions.

Join from multiple browser profiles, verify automatic TOUR room assignment and the 16-duo lobby, then open global standings and confirm the rows match the deployed database.
